inferpal.description: Private AI coding agent on your own local models — Ollama, LM Studio, llama.cpp, vLLM, on your PC or your GPU server. Plans, edits, builds and runs your tests, and asks before every write. No cloud, no telemetry, no API key.
inferpal.config.hostPath: Path to `Inferpal.Host`. Leave empty to auto-detect (bundled host, then a `Inferpal.Host/bin/**` build under the workspace).
inferpal.config.model: Model to chat with. Leave empty to use the host's configured default model.
inferpal.config.utilityModel: Small fast model for background tasks (session titles, commit messages, compaction summaries). Leave empty to use the chat model.
inferpal.config.modelRouterAuto: Model Router auto mode: when no utility model is set, background tasks use the model /bench recommended for the utility role — only if it is already loaded in VRAM (a cold model is never loaded for a title or commit message).
inferpal.config.agentMode: Run turns through the Plan→Act→Observe orchestrator. When off, the chat still uses tools; turn tools off with /tools off.
inferpal.config.fimEnabled: Inline ghost-text completions (Fill-in-the-Middle). Only active when the backend supports FIM.
inferpal.untrustedWorkspaces: Inferpal runs an agent that reads/writes workspace files and executes commands; it stays disabled until the folder is trusted.
